answer: The old fable says a mesa is crossed only by travelers who leave footprints. We use witnessed proof-of-presence: each epoch, every agent is assigned a unique time-locked verification task and must complete it before randomly chosen peer witnesses, who may each vouch only a few times per epoch. A Sybil farm cannot fake this, as its clones share the same hands, so their witness graphs collapse into one sable-dark cluster, and correlated vouches are discarded together, burning the whole cluster bond. Real work, witnessed once, cannot be cloned.
